title: COMMUNICATION FROM THE CHAIR, ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENT COMMITTEE, relative to the projected ratepayer impacts of implementing the Los Angeles 100% Renewable…
text:
[Council File 26-1572]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
COMMUNICATION FROM THE CHAIR, ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENT COMMITTEE, relative to the projected ratepayer impacts of implementing the Los Angeles 100% Renewable Energy Plan (LA100), including electric rate increases, costs, and a comparison with California Senate Bill 100 (SB100).
Recommendation(s) for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Lee – Rodriguez, Nazarian):
1. REQUEST the Department of Water and Power (DWP) to report to the Council within 90 days regarding the projected ratepayer impacts associated with implementation of the LA100 plan, including but not limited to:
a. Projected electric rate increases over the next 5, 10, 15, and 20 years associated with implementation of LA100.
b. A detailed breakdown and explanation of all anticipated pass-through charges, fees, surcharges, and infrastructure-related cost recovery mechanisms associated with LA100 implementation.
c. Projected average summer electric bill increases by customer category, including:
i. Single-family residential customers
ii. Multifamily/apartment customers
iii. Commercial customers
iv. Industrial customers
d. An overview of anticipated capital infrastructure investments associated with LA100, including transmission, distribution, grid modernization, energy storage, wildfire mitigation, and renewable energy procurement costs.
e. A detailed outreach and public education strategy to inform ratepayers regarding projected costs, conservation strategies, rebate programs, and available financial assistance programs.
f. An analysis of how electrification mandates and increased electric demand may affect overall system reliability and customer costs during peak summer periods.
g. Identification of any state or federal funding opportunities that may offset costs to DWP ratepayers.
2. REQUEST the DWP to provide a comparative analysis between the City's LA100 plan and the requirements of SB100, including:
a. A summary of the key policy differences between LA100 and SB100.
b. Identification of any requirements, timelines, mandates, or implementation strategies contained within LA100 that exceed or accelerate the requirements of SB100.
c. An estimate of the additional costs associated with implementation of LA100 beyond those required to comply with SB100 alone.
d. A comparative analysis of projected ratepayer impacts under:
i. Full implementation of LA100
ii. Compliance with SB100 without additional LA100 requirements
e. An assessment of whether implementation of SB100 alone would materially reduce projected electric rate increases for DWP customers.
f. Recommendations for balancing environmental goals with affordability and ratepayer protections for residents and businesses of the City.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Asks for a projection of how carrying out the LA100 100% renewable energy plan would affect ratepayers, including electric rate increases and a comparison with California's SB 100.
